Disappointed
Nov 2024 • Friends
After reading the positive reviews for the restaurant I was very excited to eat here. Having already viewed the menu online I walked in prepared. After requesting the wine list I was very disappointed at the extremely limited selection of wine, around 5 or 6 reds available. After my first 2 selections were out of stock I was ready to give up on wine. They offered to sell me wine from another outlet in the hotel, so now back on track. Being known for their Kobe I tried to order the Kobe filet, sadly out of stock. After 2 more selections were out of stock as well, I threw in the towel and was frustrated and skipped eating. My friend ate 2 seafood selections that he liked. It felt more like the-recent era of Covid, limited selections and out of stock items.

Posh, Excellent Kobe, A5 and A4 Wagyu, Probably needs more marketing
Sep 2020
Nestled on the second floor of New World Hotel, this relatively new restaurant looks the part of a posh Jap restaurant in a 5-star hotel. Our server was attentive and spoke good English, even gently asking if I needed more time to take some good photos of their dishes. Attentive indeed. Appreciated the careful preparation by our lady chef of the day, who also explained how we can best enjoy this delicacy with their freshly made wasabi and other specially prepared condiments. 

During our visit, we were the second couple to arrive at the restaurant at around noon, and then nobody came after us throughout our meal. While I do enjoy the peace and great service of a non-crowded restaurant, I do hope they can ramp up their marketing through various marketing channels and/or promotions (like how we did enjoy about 50% discount for this lunch), so that more people will know about and wanna try this place! We were at various other wagyu restaurants such as Hibiki, Yazawa, Ussina etc recently and... they were all packed! What a pity if not many get to try their great Kobe and Wagyu.

Great atmosphere and service.
Highly highly recommended!! Will be back again.

Amazing
Jun 2020 • Business
It’s an amazing Japanese Restaurant, a must-try place in Saigon. The food is so delicious and fresh, the space is cozy and modern. Though I am not a fan of sashimi, I love sashimi of Ibuki and only eat sashimi at this restaurant. Another must-try food is Kobe beef. I believe this is the best of the best restaurants serving Kobe beef in Saigon. You will never forget its unique taste. Last but not least, Mr. Kamo - a 20 year experienced chef (who is very nice and hospitable) will tell you the food story, the way he cooks and serves his dishes.
